title: Factory Equipment Perception & Digital Twin Real-Time Dashboard
description: Last confirmed object and pallet presence from detect ProcessEvents; event silence is not a camera health signal

tiles.title: Occupancy Rate (%)
tiles.query: CurrentPositionOccupancy | summarize Rate = round(100.0 * countif(isOccupied == true) / count(), 1)

tiles.title: Digital Twin - Last Confirmed Position State
tiles.query: CurrentPositionOccupancy | join kind=leftouter (MonitoredPositions | join kind=inner Cells on cellId | join kind=inner Plants on plantId) on $left.subjectId == $right.positionId | project Plant = plantName, Cell = cellName, Position = positionName, SubjectId = subjectId, ObservationType = observationType, Status = iff(isOccupied, 'Occupied', 'Empty'), Confidence = confidence, LastCaptured = capturedAt, Camera = sourceId | order by Cell asc

tiles.title: Presence Transitions (Last 1 Hour)
tiles.query: ConfirmedPresenceEvents | where capturedAt > ago(1h) | summarize arg_max(publishedAt, *) by eventId | order by capturedAt desc | project Timestamp = capturedAt, Subject = subjectId, ObservationType = observationType, Action = iff(isOccupied, 'Present (Occupied)', 'Absent (Empty)'), Confidence = confidence, Model = model

tiles.title: Edge-to-Cloud Latency (Seconds)
tiles.query: ProcessEventsRaw | where capturedAt > ago(30m) | extend LatencySec = datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), capturedAt) | summarize AvgLatency = avg(LatencySec) by bin(capturedAt, 1m)
